en: Two-view color postcard: the upper view shows a white church with a tall spire beside an official-looking building, captioned in Slovene; the lower view shows a tree-lined street and large buildings in a town, captioned "Pozdrav iz TOLMINA." The reverse reads "DOPISNICA," bears an Austrian 5‑heller green stamp with a TOLMIN postmark, address in cursive Slovene, and a round library stamp.
